A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VERITAS system and 64-hypothesis benchmark. All 42 pages of v1 and 43 pages of v2, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, support comparison despite the changed title and appendix organization.

before.justification: V1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, repeated-run experiments and workflow case studies on ACDC and UCSF-PDGM.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark performance, diagnostic analyses and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The four-phase workflow, agent roles and model assignments, segmentation backend, API operations and evidence-classification rule are retained. Revised diagrams and execution-limit explanations do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 64 hypotheses across ACDC and UCSF-PDGM and six complexity tiers. The descriptions formerly numbered glioma_34 and glioma_35 become glioma_18 and glioma_23; these are matched existing tasks, not additions.

E2.justification: SMa–SMe retain the same membership in the main, stratified and diagnostic comparisons under both model families. Newly cited agent systems are discussed as related work rather than evaluated as additional baselines.

E3.justification: Table 18 revises the stated coding temperature from 0.1 to 0.2. Table 2 corrects negative and underpowered/untestable control totals from 17/10 to 16/11, and several survival sample counts change, including glioma_11 from 395 subjects/229 events to 378/217. These are reported-setting corrections; the PDFs do not establish experimental reruns.

E4.justification: The vision, context, critic, decoding and model ablations, reliability analyses, SESOI sensitivity studies and failure cases are retained. V1 Appendices B–C largely become v2 Appendices C–D without new analysis questions or experiments.

E5.justification: Both versions report 10 runs per hypothesis and the same two 100-run reproducibility experiments. Median/IQR summaries, confidence intervals and uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: The coding-efficiency prose changes the local ACDC mean from 1.6 to 1.7 attempts, matching unchanged Table 12. V2 also newly calls glioma_20 REFUTED in Appendix F.3.4, conflicting with its retained SUPPORTED ground truth in Table 16; the intended label is unresolved. Main performance tables and headline accuracies remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, evidence-label conditions and power formulas are mathematically unchanged. Equation 4 merely removes division by 1 and changes formatting; no new assumptions, derivations or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The abstract adds an explicit distinction from prior AI-scientist systems, and Section 2 strengthens the positioning from competing integrated systems being limited to no prior system unifying the stated capabilities. The central functionality and performance claims remain.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 reinterprets false refutation as deficient statistical code rather than conservative agent interpretation. It adds qualifications about method-specific diagnostic pools and attributes higher frontier violations to more complex completed analyses, without new supporting experiments. Existing substantive limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Execution documentation is reconciled around eight attempts per coding round, and Figure 2 explicitly distinguishes workflow validation from evaluator-side post-hoc checking. Coding-temperature and cohort specifications are corrected. The repository disclosure moves to the abstract; access was already stated in v1.

R1.justification: Rewritten Section 2 and new Appendix B substantially broaden positioning around scientific agents, statistical-code reliability and reasoning faithfulness. Twelve references are added, including StatLLM, StatEval, DataInterpreter, TaskWeaver, ChemCrow and chain-of-thought studies, while earlier references are retained.

P1.justification: The title and abstract are revised, and substantial portions of related work, results discussion and conclusion are rewritten or condensed. Background material moves into a new extended-related-work appendix, later appendices shift, and several numbered subsections become inline headings.

P2.justification: Figure 2 changes Measures to Code, redirects statistical outputs to the evidence classifier, distinguishes the post-hoc check with a dashed connection and revises validation labels and caption. Existing figures and tables otherwise retain their content and general design, with improved rendering and relocated displays.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves clarity and reproducibility documentation by reconciling coding settings, correcting the provenance diagram and separating mechanical evidence classification from agent judgment. The expanded research positioning also clarifies the design rationale. These gains are tempered by the new glioma_20 contradiction between Appendix F.3.4 and Table 16 and diagnostic causal explanations unsupported by additional analyses.
